title: TORNADO: Adaptive Latent Stochastic Transport for Calibrated Probabilistic PDE Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.10251v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Probabilistic neural surrogates for PDEs enable ensemble forecasting, but often exhibit miscalibration when used for uncertainty quantification, especially in compute-constrained, few-step inference regimes. Existing generative approaches typically rely on fixed global stochasticity, which cannot adapt predictive uncertainty to the local dynamical state. We propose TORNADO, a latent probabilistic forecasting framework that formulates next-step prediction as stochastic transport between VAE encoder posteriors. Unlike existing approaches with globally prescribed stochasticity, TORNADO learns a SDE with state-dependent diffusion, enabling the predictive uncertainty to adapt to the local latent dynamics. The model is trained using analytic conditional endpoint targets derived from a Gaussian interpolant, enabling simulation-free learning. An additional energy distance regularization term improves distributional alignment. Empirically, TO

translated_title: TORNADO：面向校准概率偏微分方程预测的自适应潜空间随机输运
translated_abstract: 面向偏微分方程（PDE）的概率神经代理模型能够支持集合预报，但在用于不确定性量化时常表现出校准失准，尤其是在计算资源受限、推理步数较少的场景下。现有的生成式方法通常依赖于固定的全局随机性，无法使预测不确定性适应当地的动力学状态。我们提出了TORNADO，这是一种潜空间概率预测框架，它将下一步预测表述为VAE编码器后验分布之间的随机输运。与现有采用全局规定随机性的方法不同，TORNADO学习一个具有状态依赖扩散项的随机微分方程（SDE），使预测不确定性能够自适应于局部潜空间动力学。该模型使用由高斯插值推导出的解析条件端点目标进行训练，实现了无需模拟（simulation-free）的学习。此外，引入能量距离正则化项以改善分布对齐。实验上，TO（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: TORNADO提出了一种潜空间概率预测框架，通过学习具有状态依赖扩散项的SDE在VAE后验分布之间进行随机输运，实现无需模拟的训练，从而在计算受限的少步推理下为PDE预测提供校准的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: TORNADO is a latent probabilistic forecasting framework that learns a state-dependent-diffusion SDE for stochastic transport between VAE encoder posteriors, enabling simulation-free training and calibrated uncertainty quantification for PDE forecasting under compute-constrained, few-step inference.
